type classify_ionization = (_: {

// Return fraction of aromatic atoms.
type get_fraction_aromatic_atoms = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return aromatic atom count.
type get_num_aromatic_atoms = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

type get_max_abs_partial_charge = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return min absolute Gasteiger partial charge.
type get_min_abs_partial_charge = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return max EState index among atoms.
type get_max_estate_index = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return min EState index among atoms.
type get_min_estate_index = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

// Return Bertz complexity index.
type get_bertz_ct = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;

type get_balaban_j = (_: {
// SMILES string of the molecule.
smiles: string
}) => any;
